This update for PackageKit fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-10294: manipulation of the argument frontend-socket can lead to improper authorization (bsc#1267250).

Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability has been found in PackageKit up to 1.3.5. Affected is the function g_file_test of the file src/pk-transaction.c of the component API. Such manipulation of the argument frontend-socket leads to improper authorization. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
